verdict.rationale: Trello documents a Power-Up marketplace where third-party developers submit integrations, and users can find the apps their team already uses and link their favorite tools to boards. That covers the core of the story. The "thousands of tools" scale is never quantified, and there are no hands-on reports of browsing or installing marketplace apps. One community note cites add-on restrictions for solo users, which is a plan limitation rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence of the marketplace's breadth (thousands of tools), a detailed install/connect walkthrough, and independent corroboration of marketplace use.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace
